title: Parapsychology master's program at John F. Kennedy University

tellings.quote: since I used to teach at John F. Kennedy University back in around 1980 uh when they had a master's degree in parasychology

plain: Around 1980, John F. Kennedy University in California offered a master's degree in parapsychology, the study of things like telepathy and psychic ability. Jeffrey Mishlove, a PhD who says he taught there at the time, mentions it in passing. He tells it as part of his own background, showing that a university once treated the subject as a field of graduate study.
